name: Maid Cafe Simulator
source:
Become the new manager of a small, rundown "maid cafe" in Maid Cafe Simulator!

In a world drained of emotions by digital overload, unique kemonomimi maids with their own secrets and personalities await you. Revive the struggling cafe with these maids who trust and rely on you, and take on the fierce competition to claim the maid cafe industry's highest honor: the "Maidchelin 3 Stars"!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3232690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在女仆咖啡馆模拟器中成为一家破旧的小“女仆咖啡馆”的新经理！

在一个因数字超载而耗尽情感的世界中，拥有自己的秘密和个性的独特kemonomimi女仆等待着你。和这些信任你、依靠你的女仆们一起重振苦苦挣扎的咖啡馆，并在激烈的竞争中夺取女仆咖啡馆行业的最高荣誉：“Maidchelin 3 Stars”！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3232690/]Steam[/url]]
